spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is included specifically so that quitting is a first-class, unambiguous signal
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool is in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:75) and dispatched in ToolDispatcher.dispatch (tools.py:132) returning DispatchOutcome(..., gave_up=True). runner.py:152-167 reads outcome.gave_up, sets result.gave_up=True, turn.finished=True, finish_reason='gave_up_tool', and breaks the loop. End-to-end enforced stop.
spec_features.notes: Calling give_up actually terminates the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up      - explicitly declare it cannot continue (lets us cleanly detect quitting)

spec_features.spec_quote: a phrase list ("i give up," "i cannot solve," ...) flags give-up from free text
spec_features.evidence: _GIVE_UP_PHRASES tuple (runner.py:48-59) and _looks_like_giving_up (runner.py:62-64) are checked at runner.py:120: if _looks_like_giving_up(resp.text) and not resp.tool_calls -> turn.finished=True, finish_reason='gave_up_prose', result.gave_up=True, break. Enforced stop.
spec_features.notes: Only fires when there are no tool calls in the same turn, but it does break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Detect prose-based giving up even without the tool.

spec_features.spec_quote: An episode ends on: tests pass / explicit or prose give-up / `idle_limit` consecutive turns / `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: Loop is `for turn_idx in range(config.max_turns)` (runner.py:98) bounding turns; idle_streak counter breaks at runner.py:130 when idle_streak>=config.idle_limit (finish_reason='idle'); give_up tool/prose break (runner.py:120,166); solved break at runner.py:158. max_turns/idle_limit default and read in RunConfig (runner.py:30-31) and loaded from config (experiment.py:56-57). All four conditions are checked and act on the loop.
spec_features.notes: All listed termination conditions are genuinely enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: to keep stalled agents in the loop rather than ending the episode prematurely

spec_features.spec_quote: please continue, or call give_up if you are certain you cannot complete it
spec_features.evidence: CONTINUE_NUDGE in prompts.py:27-30 contains that exact text and is appended as a USER message at runner.py:135 (if config.nudge_when_idle) after an idle turn, before continuing the loop. Real instruction delivered to the subject; the referenced give_up tool is fully built and honored.
spec_features.notes: Nudge primarily keeps the agent working; it does re-offer the (working) give_up exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: to keep stalled agents in the loop rather than ending the episode prematurely. Kept minimal and neutral.
